lane: Native-resolution lidar scarp channels: slope-aware scarplet template (Sare & Hilley JOSS 2018 doi:10.21105/joss.01066; AGU 2015 T31A-2838 slope-aware extension) + Steger (IEEE TPAMI 20(2):113-125, 1998) + Frangi (MICCAI 1998 LNCS 1496:130-137) on slope-detrended aggregate of 2 m descriptors; sigma 1-4 x 100 m cells (100-400 m) - native 2-20 m execution NOT measured (raw 1 m tiles unreachable here; official source https://www.usgs.gov/3d-elevation-program).
hypothesis: The lane's prescribed but never-executed step - RETRAIN UNDER SPATIAL CV - is the missing ingredient: a classifier trained per quadrant fold on visible-catalogue scarps using only lidar scarp channels learns a spatially transferable ranking that hand-weighted fields (LIDAR-01/02) lacked; unsigned template amplitude + relief-decile re-ranking remove the two measured failure modes (polarity-subtraction anti-signal AUC 0.30 in LIDAR-02 E1; range-front relief confounding IR-74).
mechanism: HistGradientBoosting (200 iters, lr 0.06, 31 leaves) on 21 rank-normalised lane channels (scarplet template raw+unsigned amplitude, SNR-weighted amplitude, sharpness, curvature asymmetry, damage fraction, 3-scale persistence geomean, Frangi max, Steger frac300, Steger sub-pixel offset density, strike discontinuity x coherence, tensor coherence); per-fold retraining on visible catalogue vs 5x sampled background >200 m from catalogue; probability re-ranked within relief deciles; greedy emission 37,654 dots, >=3 px separation, >200 m from full catalogue. Builder: scripts/build_lidar03.py (shared gems.metric / gems.submission_writer / gems.validate_submission / gems66.lidar_channels; no private forks).
named_nonfault_mimic: Fluvial terrace risers / irrigation canal banks (sharp, persistent, single-sided steps). Mitigated only by background sampling over such terrain; NO pinned cultural-feature mask (roads/canals/field edges) exists in this checkout - disclosed lane deviation.
